I bought this on sale a while ago and had vol. 2 on my wishlist, waiting for discount. But when I checked it today, I found the author has deleted their account. I don't know why, but the DLsite page for tracking removed works (/maniax/info/sellend/=/month/yyyy-mm) is also gone, so I checked Doujin DB instead. It seems, the author uploaded a 1-week limited complete collection on Mar 25, and then by Mar 31, they had removed all of their works. Though I have followed them on DLsite and Pixiv, but I did not notice that.😓
